title: EFT_Operator_Scan: photon-dark-matter elastic scattering, effective-operator scan and Galactic-halo sensitivity
description: Analysis code and figure-generation scripts reproducing every figure in "Photon-Dark Matter Elastic Scattering: An Effective-Operator Scan and First Operator-Resolved Sensitivity Estimates from the Galactic Halo". Includes the operator cross sections, the two-channel removal and ROI-recovery treatment, the halo and IGRB scans, the digitised external constraint set with per-curve provenance, and the paper figure pipeline.
